edits.target: In reviews, explicitly call out missing bounded-allocation handling (`try_reserve`), missing checked capacity/summary arithmetic, missing checked conversions, and unsafe/SIMD paths without a scalar fallback.
edits.content: - **Review Completeness:** In review mode, you must identify ALL violation categories present in the code (I/O in core, unwrap/panic, unchecked arithmetic, missing try_reserve, etc.). Do not stop after finding the first issue. Report all findings in the JSON output.
